messages:
Diego (Partnerships): heads up — AccelX just flagged that our upcoming response header rename (x-rdwd-proto -> x-rdwd-v2) will break their marketplace adapter. They asked for a 3‑week runway. do we have a recommended migration path? :thinking:
Olivia (Eng): thanks for the ping. the change is mostly additive but we do change some envelope shapes for streaming. for non-streaming they should be fine if they accept unknown headers. the problem is their adapter does strict header validation.
Raj (Eng-Infra): can we add a compatibility mode on our side that preserves the old header for flagged partners? maybe a config flag at the routing layer.
Olivia (Eng): yeah we can. quick option: introduce a routing rule that injects both headers for requests from marketplace-v1 partners for 30 days. low-risk.
Emma (PM): timeline? AccelX wants comms by EoW and a firm date 2 weeks after. they also asked for a sample test harness so they can run smoke tests in their CI.
Diego (Partnerships): I told them we'd aim to give a migration guide + canary date by Friday. can we commit to the dual-header routing and a small test harness?
Raj (Eng-Infra): I can wire a toggle behind a feature flag and expose a sample curl test. something like:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
     -H "x-rdwd-proto: 1" \
     -H "x-rdwd-v2: 1" \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Olivia (Eng): i'll add the routing rule + telemetry to the rollout checklist. telemetry: flag when request contains only old header, only new header, or both. helps partner verification.
Emma (PM): partner comms draft: "We will send both headers for requests originating from the AccelX marketplace until 2025-12-15; please validate your adapter using the sample tests we provide. After that date we will stop sending the old header." sound ok?
Diego (Partnerships): good. i'll update AccelX legal/ops and share the test harness. can we also provide a tiny node snippet for their integration team?
Olivia (Eng): yes — i'll commit a small snippet and the harness to a private gist and share link.
partner-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag toggle for dual-header routing queued for canary at 2025-11-08T03:00Z. see: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4521 :rocket:
Diego (Partnerships): perfect. next steps: 1) olivia/raj implement dual-header + telemetry 2) emma approves comms 3) diego shares harness + date with AccelX. i'll follow up in a short thread for the partner announcement copy. :thumbsup:
